mechanism: DeepL and Yandex hardcode their endpoint, so the pinned server runs with only its node-fetch module replaced by a controlled peer (tools/lib/pinned-outbound.mjs). Libre/DeepLX/OneRing/Lingva take the URL from a secret, so the probe points that secret at a test host and the Go side points it at a local listener.

fields.reason: Express and the pinned middleware stack set them
the translated text and the empty-body case are endpoint behaviour
constructed upstream URL, including defaults, url-join and the yandex ucid shape
exact JSON body or application/x-www-form-urlencoded string, including parameter ORDER
only the declared content-type/authorization headers are asserted
third-party content: the fixture supplies the peer payload and asserts the extraction

normalizations: The Yandex ucid is a fresh uuidv4 per request, so it is replaced by <uuid> in the recorded outbound URL; it is the only nondeterministic value in this domain.
The DeepL formality value comes from config (`deepl.formality`), which the probe does not configure, so the pinned default "default" is what is recorded. A configured formality is NOT pinned.
